_about: Ranger Burl's story jobs (scripts/camp/camp_story.gd; owner picks 26 Oct 2026, the cozy-games case study): after the arrival evening he gives the players one job at a time, in person, that walks them through the camp. Talking to him gives the next job; once it is done the '!' shows over him again, and talking to him thanks them, pays coins and gives the next one. need says what finishes a job: has:<kind> counts that build standing in the camp now (data/build.json kinds), stars the camp's star rating (data/rating.json), and anything else is a step the players take after he asks, matched like the odd jobs (data/tasks.json: give, cook, plant, build:<kind>...); count is how many. coins are paid when he thanks them. ask and thanks are his lines (text keys, data/text.json job.<id>.*), and goal is the short line on the HUD and in the morning report. Nothing is timed: a job waits for as long as it takes, and either player can do it. A camp that never played the arrival evening (older saves) starts at the first job.
